assessments.reasoning: The questionnaire does not include unpaid domestic and care work within the definition of work or economic activity. Section A filters out unpaid work unless it was conducted for a business or enterprise belonging to a family member (a4). Unpaid family care and domestic duties are mentioned in Section J (j7) as reasons for not seeking work, placing them in the category of non-occupation/inactivity.
